en.welcome:
Hi {name}! 👋 Welcome to Morsely 💙

Your simple Morse code converter.

Send plain text or Morse code, and I'll automatically detect the conversion direction.
en.help_text: ❓ How to use Morsely 1️⃣ Text → Morse code Send normal text, and Morsely will convert it into Morse code. 📩 You send: HELLO WORLD 🤖 Morsely replies: .... . .-.. .-.. --- / .-- --- .-. .-.. -.. 2️⃣ Morse code → Text Send Morse code, and Morsely will convert it into readable text. 📩 You send: ... --- ... 🤖 Morsely replies: SOS 💡 Tip: Separate Morse letters with spaces and words with /.
en.about_text: ℹ️ About Morsely Morsely is a simple Morse code converter. Send text or Morse code and Morsely handles the conversion.
en.support_text: ✉️ Contact Morsely Support Have a question, found a bug, or have a suggestion? Feel free to contact us! 📧 Email: kacemlabs.store@gmail.com 💬 Telegram: @kacem_la 🤖 Need a custom bot? I can create custom Telegram bots for your needs. Contact me to discuss your idea.
en.donation_text: 💙 Support Morsely Every contribution helps us improve Morsely. Any amount is greatly appreciated. Thank you for your support!
en.binance_text: 💛 Support Morsely with Binance Pay Thank you for supporting Morsely! Scan the QR code using the Binance app or use the Binance Pay ID below to send any amount you wish. Binance Pay ID: {binance_id} Every contribution means a lot to us. Thank you! 💙
en.redotpay_text: ❤️ Support Morsely with RedotPay Thank you for supporting Morsely! Scan the QR code using the RedotPay app or use the receiving ID below to send any amount you wish. RedotPay ID: {redotpay_id} We truly appreciate your support! 💙
en.kofi_text: ☕ Support Morsely on Ko-fi Open our Ko-fi page and choose the amount you would like to contribute. Every contribution helps us improve the bot. Thank you! 💙
en.paypal_text: ⏳ PayPal — Coming Soon We're working on making PayPal available. Thank you for your patience and support! 💙
en.crypto_text: ₿ Support Morsely with Crypto Choose a cryptocurrency, then select its network. Please check the minimum deposit before sending.
en.choose_network: Choose the network for {currency}. ⚠️ Make sure the sending and receiving networks match.
en.crypto_address: 💙 Thank you for supporting Morsely! Currency: {currency} Network: {network} ⚠️ Important: Check the minimum deposit before sending. Minimum deposit requirements may change. Confirm the current minimum on the receiving platform before donating. Send only {currency} on the {network} network to this address: {address} Thank you for every contribution! 💙
en.crypto_unavailable: That currency or network is not configured.

Votre convertisseur simple de code Morse.

Envoyez du texte ou du Morse et je détecterai automatiquement le sens de conversion.
fr.help_text: ❓ Comment utiliser Morsely 1️⃣ Texte → Code Morse Envoyez un texte normal et Morsely le convertira en code Morse. 📩 Vous envoyez : HELLO WORLD 🤖 Morsely répond : .... . .-.. .-.. --- / .-- --- .-. .-.. -.. 2️⃣ Code Morse → Texte Envoyez du code Morse et Morsely le convertira en texte lisible. 📩 Vous envoyez : ... --- ... 🤖 Morsely répond : SOS 💡 Conseil : Séparez les lettres Morse par des espaces et les mots avec /.
fr.about_text: ℹ️ À propos de Morsely Morsely est un convertisseur simple de code Morse.
fr.support_text: ✉️ Assistance Morsely Une question, un bug ou une suggestion ? N'hésitez pas à nous contacter ! 📧 E-mail : kacemlabs.store@gmail.com 💬 Telegram : @kacem_la 🤖 Besoin d'un bot personnalisé ? Je peux créer des bots Telegram personnalisés selon vos besoins. Contactez-moi pour discuter de votre idée !
